answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28913 Country: India Title: An allopathy doctor advised me to take heart surgery*bypass* according to islam can i take that surgical treatment or should go to an unani doctor? Kindly tell me quickly as i am in an emergency medical ward... Question: an allopathy doctor advised me to take heart surgery*bypass* according to islam can i take that surgical treatment or should go to an unani doctor? Kindly tell me quickly as i am in an emergency medical ward... Answer ID: 28913 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 117/87/D=1432) Shariah does not forbid to undergo such type of treatment. It allows adopting any lawful treatment according to one’s ease. Yes, you should seek the advice of the expert doctors regarding the usefulness of the treatment for you and see whether your financial condition allows such types costly treatment or not? You should also seek the advice of your family members and your well-wishers regarding the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
